XECH- LumosX Table Lamp Multifunctional with Wireless Speaker

Upgrade your workspace, bedroom, or living area with the XECH- LumosX Table Lamp Multifunctional with Wireless Speaker, a perfect blend of smart lighting, immersive sound, and everyday convenience. Designed for modern lifestyles, this innovative lamp goes beyond basic illumination by combining a high-quality wireless speaker, ambient night light, and smart organizer in one sleek device.

Whether you are working late, studying, relaxing, or hosting a small gathering, this table lamp with wireless speaker adapts effortlessly to your needs. With vibrant RGB lighting, multiple brightness levels, and intuitive touch controls, it creates the ideal atmosphere for productivity, relaxation, or entertainment.

Smart Lighting with Style and Comfort

The LumosX features energy-efficient LEDs that deliver consistent, eye-friendly illumination. Choose from 3 levels of brightness to suit reading, working, or soft ambient lighting. The flexible gooseneck allows you to adjust the lamp angle easily, ensuring focused light exactly where you need it.

As an ambient night light, it offers a soothing glow that enhances comfort without straining your eyes. This makes it ideal for bedside tables, kids’ rooms, or late-night study sessions.

RGB Party Lights with Multiple Modes

Transform your space instantly with built-in RGB party lights. Choose from 8 vibrant colors and 5 dynamic lighting modes to match your mood or occasion. From calm evenings to lively gatherings, the lighting effects add a modern, stylish touch to any environment.

Wireless Speaker for Music & Calls

Enjoy clear, immersive audio with the integrated wireless speaker. Seamlessly connect your smartphone or tablet to stream music, podcasts, or attend hands-free calls. This makes the LumosX not just a lamp, but a complete entertainment and productivity companion for your desk or bedside.

Designed for Everyday Convenience

This multifunctional lamp doubles as a smart phone stand and tablet holder, allowing you to watch videos, follow recipes, or attend video calls comfortably. The built-in pen and stationery holder keeps your workspace organized and clutter-free, making it ideal for home offices, students, and professionals.

Rechargeable & Energy Efficient

Powered by a long-lasting rechargeable battery, the LumosX ensures portability and uninterrupted usage. The energy efficient LEDs consume less power while delivering excellent brightness, making it an eco-friendly lighting solution for daily use.

Touch Sensor Controls

Experience effortless operation with responsive touch sensor controls. Adjust brightness, change colors, or switch modes with a simple tap. The intuitive interface ensures a smooth and modern user experience without complicated buttons.

Key Features at a Glance

  • Multifunctional table lamp with built-in wireless speaker
  • Ambient night light with RGB party lights (8 colors, 5 modes)
  • 3 brightness levels with touch sensor controls
  • Energy efficient LED lighting
  • Rechargeable battery for cordless convenience
  • Flexible gooseneck for adjustable lighting angles
  • Smart phone stand and tablet holder
  • Pen and stationery holder for organized desks

Perfect for Home, Office & Gifting

The XECH- LumosX Table Lamp Multifunctional with Wireless Speaker is an excellent choice for bedrooms, study tables, work-from-home setups, and dorm rooms. Its modern design and practical features also make it a thoughtful gift for students, professionals, and tech enthusiasts.

Bring together smart lighting, immersive sound, and everyday organization in one elegant solution. Choose LumosX to redefine how you light, listen, and live.
